user_authority: Leave the current dashboard completely unchanged and patch only logging for Codex research.
Establish periodic storage cleanup while excluding valuable research outputs.
Do not reattach or restart the EA in a way that skips today's trading opportunities.
Do not add validators or other tests.

candidate_ledger: blocked signal candidates including risk, minimum-lot, margin, quote, session, broker and ownership reason
requested price, volume, stop and planned risk
risk capital, per-position cap, aggregate risk before/after, cap and headroom
active and reserved component masks, slot counts and US30/US100 book risk/direction
prior same-symbol nonzero signal direction with FIRST, PERSIST or REVERSE relation
exact UTC, server time and UTC-minute macro-event join key
lifecycle_ledger: stable position identifier and entry context
mark-to-market profit memory with peak, trough and maximum giveback in USD and planned-risk R
first natural expert close of another still-held component
actual and stressed lifecycle result plus exit reason/class
fixed_observation_scope.research_state: Independent optional alternating A/B observer state, saved after decisions/exits and on the existing 60-second snapshot cadence.
fixed_observation_scope.external_event_policy: No network or calendar dependency enters the EA. Exact UTC/server timestamps provide a causal offline join key for later Codex research.

non_interference_contract.core_event_ring: unchanged; research rows never consume safety-event capacity
non_interference_contract.research_failure_effect: Print one bounded warning and count a dropped research record only; never set persistence_failed, safety_stopped, broker_mismatch or change an order decision.
non_interference_contract.pre_order_disk_io: forbidden; passed-signal rows are written only after the order/admission path has completed

storage_rule.trigger: First weekend of each calendar month, and before any new Lab Portable when system-drive free space is below 30 GiB.
always_preserve: every artifact named or hashed by durable evidence
active forward baseline and active Live package/state/events
canonical research candidate and lifecycle ledgers
storage_rule.safety: No owner process may be using a target. Resolve and record exact absolute targets first; uncertainty means retain. No automatic destructive worker is added.

fixed_verification.compile: Normal MetaEditor build 6140 compile must report 0 errors and 0 warnings.
fixed_verification.economic_path: Exactly one normal fixed P4 2026-YTD FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks path after the candidate source/configuration is frozen.
fixed_verification.economic_requirement: Actual net, stressed net, lifecycle/deal counts, risk skips, stop exits and fault counters exactly match the frozen CXR2 Lab control; research rows must be populated and remain causally separate.
fixed_verification.live_observation: Only after a later stopped-flat promotion, one bounded entries-disabled recovery/restart observation followed by the existing exact 0/0 to 1/1 handoff.

current_day_no_skip_gate.earliest_handoff: After every 2026-08-26 scheduled entry window has expired and all owned positions, pending orders, margin, planned risk, retry, shadow and ARC state are locally proven zero at a stopped-flat boundary.
current_day_no_skip_gate.late_entry_policy: Never manufacture a late replacement for any expired opportunity.
current_day_no_skip_gate.failed_handoff_policy: Remain on the existing owner or entries-disabled according to the existing fail-closed runbook; never skip ahead to a 1/1 start.

live_promotion.release_requirement: New frozen release/source manifests and hashes while preserving the exact Live execution version, economic identity, Portfolio, Magic, settings and core state schema/path.
